label: Tanec · Flamenco minutový
desc: Pomalý nástup, dupání, kroužení zápěstí, tleskání, otočky se sukní, hrdý závěr. 12 beatů ≈ 52 s.
desc_en: A slow entrance, heel stamping, circling wrists, claps, spins with the skirt, a proud finish. 12 beats, about 52 s.
style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed
negative: blurry, low quality, watermark, text, distorted face, extra fingers, bad anatomy, extra limbs

scenes.name: intro
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: the dancer stands tall and slowly raises their chin, one arm curving up in front of them, and ends with the arm held high
the dancer draws a slow circle with their wrist above their head while their other hand rests on their hip, and ends with both hands on their hips
the dancer stomps their heels on the floor three times, arching them back with each stomp, and ends with their chin raised

scenes.name: main
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: the dancer slowly raises both arms overhead, wrists twisting in circular flamenco wrist-work, and ends with arms high
the dancer claps their hands sharply above their head once and snaps their face toward the camera, then holds
the dancer spins once, their skirt flaring out in a wide arc around their legs, and ends facing the camera as the skirt settles
the dancer steps forward with a sharp heel strike and sweeps one arm across their body, and ends with the arm extended to the side
the dancer stomps twice more, faster, with their hands framing their face, and ends still with their hands raised
the dancer spins in the other direction, skirt flaring, and ends facing the camera with one hand on their hip

scenes.name: finale
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: the dancer slowly lowers both arms in a wide arc down to their sides, and ends with palms resting on their thighs
the dancer strikes a proud final stance, one hand on their hip and head tilted back, and holds it perfectly still
the dancer relaxes the pose, breathes out and smiles at the camera, and ends standing still
